topic: Rewards in BTC, costs in fiat
hook: Miners earn in bitcoin but pay their bills in dollars.

scenes.narration: Mining rewards are paid in BTC. But electricity and hosting are paid in regular currency.
That means profit moves with the bitcoin price, even if the miner runs the same hardware.
No return is ever promised. A good month can be followed by a poor one.

cta: How do you track this? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Why Miners Earn in BTC but Pay in Fiat
description_body: Rewards arrive in BTC while costs are paid in fiat, so profit moves with price.
